title: Laundry in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Self-service Waschsalons are everywhere except the tourist core.** Chains like Eco-Express and Schnell & Sauber run daily from 06:00, in Prenzlauer Berg, Kreuzberg, Schoeneberg, Charlottenburg and Neukoelln.
**A full self-service run costs about 11 to 12 euro**: roughly 5.50 to 6 euro for the wash, about 5 euro for 30 minutes of drying, under 1 euro for detergent from the vending machine.

**Wash-and-fold is the underrated tourist option.** At Freddy Leck in Moabit a 6 kg load washed, dried and bagged is 11.90 euro, folded 15.40 euro. Drop it in the morning, collect it 4 to 6 hours later.
**Sunday is a great laundry day.** Shops close, but the laundromat chains run seven days a week, most from 06:00 to 22:00 or 23:00.
**Bring coins anyway.** Many machines still want them, card readers are the exception, and the last coin insertion is often 21:00 even when the salon closes at 22:00.
